<!-- r1-handoff-20261008 -->
## Handoff checkpoint — 2026-10-08

Execution is stopped at the user's request. All workers are settled; active R1 runtime, SSH and fetch commands joined; Linux111's R1 reservation is genuinely released. **Resume from the [durable handoff guide and evidence packet](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/8994a4b22c465da5d1231f2ce0c937d5441c3c8a/docs/evidence/r1-5090-handoff-20261008/README.md)**, then refresh live heads, dependencies, reviews/CI and host ownership. The guide contains exact source branches, failures, source-only acceptance, unexecuted checks, preserved evidence and the restart order. Earlier checkpoint status below is historical. No product or performance acceptance is implied, and this ticket remains open.

**This node:** draft #5104 preserves head113e5b2d. Focused 4K/16K point/range and held32 evidence exists; the 16K mixed-churn +9.993% median remains unaccepted. The accepted causal mapping points to M/C/P publication/construction/admission residuals plus the narrow #5015 owner. Resolve that mapped work, then rerun the fixed 10,000 complete-read protocol with actual merged identities. Do not infer exclusive fsync cost by subtracting inclusive timings.

<!-- /r1-handoff-20261008 -->

## Accepted execution contract v3 — 2026-10-07

#5091 decision packet is merged in #5100 at44a72f3856cac51afdb09e60c5394706f261e930 (reviewed supporting head e1e0b63ac998806c12f42943ddc8b8d91056dc81). Accepted target/admission/ownership contract: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6034625243 and its recorded corrections. Production runtime baseline797d783b remains identical across that tests/docs merge.

Required measurement prerequisite #5101 lands actual source-byte binding, explicit read counts and compatible bounded public GC/ACK samplers before new qualifying #5092/#5095 captures and full #5096. The next matched read protocol is10000 complete-read calls,50 mutation calls, batch32 and4096/16384 populations; targets and both noise rules remain fixed. The prior1000-read blocks remain retained and unaccepted; longer-exposure/key-coverage decision: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091#issuecomment-6039866047. Earlier failed/noisy/unlanded-overlay blocks remain diagnostic. Runtime predecessor and final qualification gates remain mandatory; no runtime or parent performance acceptance yet.

## Goal

Replace duplicated one-shot and per-row reconstruction setup with one captured row execution plan that serves complete Get/GetInto, prepared batches and bounded indexed ranges. Emit into the selected caller-owned destination without an intermediate complete owned JSON document/copy. Primary deliverable: **PR**, consuming accepted [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) and the required merged shared-emitter slice owned by #1887. Closure of unrelated broader #1887 vector/projected obligations is not required; [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) records the exact landed prerequisite and its native/scoped owner gate when selected.

## Source and architecture direction

[GetInto](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/blob/b21d017758b167aecc23a4d1afc7fb8148d09d7a/TreeDB/collections/api.go#L22680) currently reconstructs into another owned result, closes its ephemeral view and appends that result into dst. Get may additionally trim excess capacity. Ordinary ranges share a snapshot materializer but produce per-row owned arenas; the prepared 32-row route uses primary GetMany with individual locators below its grouped threshold.

Reuse `CollectionReadView`, `documentMaterializer`, immutable cached catalog, existing snapshot-bound locator/point-row readers, source-directory V2, mappedresource guards and the shared verified offset memo. Define one reader plan per captured generation and explicit request/batch scratch ownership. Bound the view-owned pointRowBlocks/decoded-offset retention separately from the existing global memo, including live held owners and eviction/release behavior. Unify public routing, retained-residual merge, locator lookup and output sinks. #1887 owns type-specific JSON emission; this issue integrates that primitive and owns executor/output lifetime, not a duplicate serializer.

Classic full-manifest preparation, cold full-asset validation/offset indexing and versions excluded from offset memoization require the [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) selected strategy. Reuse certified generation/asset metadata where sound. New persistent point metadata or a row format is conditional on a causal scaling decision; preserve source-directory V2's existing point-local route and fail-closed unknown/corrupt formats. Audit the apparently unused `ensureDocumentRowLocator` helper only after a complete consumer search; preserve live no-locator visibility fallback.

## Scope and structural exit

- One captured publication binds index IDs, locators, residual bytes and typed fields. Ordinary reads still drain/observe their documented pending state; held views retain their own snapshot.
- A caller-provided GetInto buffer is the final construction destination. Handle residual/destination aliasing and undersized/growing buffers safely before direct emission. Full row output requires its owned bytes, but no second complete reconstruction buffer is allocated only to copy to dst.
- Request setup is amortized per batch/view, not repeated for each returned row. Selected eligible point lookup does not rescan all physical rows/manifests per ID after the captured reader is prepared.
- Existing offset/asset caches remain bounded and identity/generation bound; count held-view owners separately. Cold validation and setup are charged and reported rather than moved outside the timer silently.
- Arbitrary retained JSON, missing/null fields, projection, vectors/lists and unsupported storage versions keep correct fallback behavior. No promise of a universal new typed carrier.

## Test-first and measurement

Extend document_materializer_test.go, r1_reads_5058_test.go, column_reconstruction_test.go and column_physical_row_reader_test.go. Start with public tests for sufficient-dst reuse/owned result after close and concurrent mutation, same-captured index/fetch with pending writes and tombstones, classic and source-directory routes, corrupt manifests/assets, fallback and projection/vector parity. Add work counters/assertions proving no temporary full-row handoff copy and no per-result full inventory on the selected strategy. A behavior-preserving consolidation may use existing characterization plus a failing allocation/work invariant.

Compare complete point Get/GetInto, prepared 32-row fetch and ordinary/prepared 10-row ranges (the historical index-IDs plus held-fetch composition is quiescence-only; use same-view index selection for concurrent snapshot claims), cold/first-use/warm/setup, narrow/wide rows and row/asset-count scaling. Preserve complete output and caller lifetimes. Require the [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) read cost objective plus structural exits, B/op/allocs, cache capacity/held retention and throughput/latency; no SQLite memory claim from Go-only counts.

Edit map: `api.go`, `document_materializer.go`, `column_reconstruction.go` integration only, `column_physical_visibility.go`, `column_source_directory_v2.go`, row-reader/asset-manager eligibility as selected. Update `r1-row-reads.md`, `typed-row-store.md`, `typed-storage-performance.md`, `contracts.md`, `verification.md`; storage-format/recovery only if [#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) selects a format change.

- [ ] Shared captured reader and public path/counter proof; obsolete duplicate routes removed where safe.
- [ ] Direct owned-output construction and lifetime/fallback/corruption tests pass.
- [ ] Material complete-read improvement and scaling gates pass without unaccounted setup/retention tradeoffs.
- [ ] Shared #1887 consumer semantics and docs pass; current-head PR gates pass.


## Shared execution contract

Parent: [#5090](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5090). Planning base: `b21d017758b167aecc23a4d1afc7fb8148d09d7a`; recheck affected production paths and owners before implementation. Read the parent's semantic, performance, documentation and reassessment contract.

This is a **performance-objective** packet. Prove the real public caller → eligibility → optimized primitive → fallback, with path/work counters; helper-only timings are insufficient. First capture the named invariant failing for the intended reason, or record a justified characterization exception for a behavior-preserving refactor. Run affected races, recovery/reopen and fault tests. Compare identical before/after commands and equivalent returned data, visibility, ownership and durable ACKs; report latency/throughput, B/op, allocs/op, setup/first-use, retained/peak memory and relevant storage/I/O/work counters. Charge allocations by row/request/batch/setup, and account for backing capacity and pins. Minimize avoidable copies/temporary representations before completion.

[#5091](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5091) freezes the workload, numeric objective/budgets and noise policy **before candidate measurements**, from phase-attributed baselines. A pass requires the structural gate below and a repeatable material improvement beyond that policy; no-regression alone does not pass. If improvement is insufficient, profile and revise this packet or map a blocking replacement before final qualification. Unexplained material regressions block; an accepted necessary residual needs evidence, alternatives and explicit acceptance.

Use an isolated topic branch and PR; preserve unrelated work. Current repository policy requires a PR and strict current-head `TreeDB required gate`; the required formal-approval count is zero. Refresh rules before merge. Request credit-consuming AI review only for mature code/tests/performance evidence/docs, resolve findings, and repeat only for changed evidence. No execution or merge is performed by publishing these issues.
